quirks.data_note: QCP has no SOL export; state snapshots are Save ICs (text { VAR "Name" value }), history via Options > Clipboard.
quirks.stop_note: Stop (24) is grayed when idle; wait_idle uses two-phase detection (enabled -> grayed).
quirks.hemorrhage_panel: not a menu page; reached via Clinical Buttons page (canvas buttons) - not yet mapped
quirks.start_note: QCP 2005.EXE exits within seconds when started hidden+detached (hummod_start hidden=True); start with hidden=False, then attach.
quirks.slider_note: QCP sliders commit model values (unlike 3.0.4), BUT SB_THUMBPOSITION to position 0 is ignored; set_slider falls back to SB_LINELEFT steps for pos 0. Slider pos->value maps are non-linear per slider (e.g. Diet Table Salt: pos 1-10 step +1, pos 11-27 step +10, pos 28-43 step +20; range 0-43).
quirks.reflow_note: Page control rects shift on window restore/repaint (e.g. Diet slider column moved x=44 -> x=382 screen); re-inspect controls before coordinate-based clicks, ordinals stay stable.
quirks.ics_note: Save ICs holds only ~1370 STATE variables (pools, gains, clamps). Derived outcomes (MAP, atrial pressures, hormone concentrations, excretion rates) are NOT in the ICS - read them from the page canvases via hummod_shot (Blood Pressure page 144 shows MAP/SBP/DBP/RAP/LAP at once).
quirks.go_step_is_solver_step: The Go duration IS the solver solution interval: a 30-min Go writes SOLNINT=30/DISPINT=2/DX=2 into the ICS, a 10-min Go writes SOLNINT=10/DISPINT=0.5/DX=0.5. Same-protocol reruns reproduce bit-for-bit, but changing the step length also changes the RANDOM/NORMAL noise sequence; observed 90-min endpoint differences between 30-min and 10-min step protocols stayed <=~2% on core pools (glucose/insulin mass), so event timing (coma, CV collapse) is step-length insensitive on this stiff model - step-length effects show through SAMPLING density, not dynamics.
quirks.slider_pos0_verified: SB_LINELEFT fallback for pos 0 verified on the Infusion Pumps insulin rate slider (Setting 1000->0 and 20->0, both committed exactly).
quirks.consciousness_note: No dedicated consciousness variable; 'Posture Control, Recent Coma' (ICS) latches to 1 after a faint and never resets - combine with Monitor page vitals (RR/HR/BP/Temp); death = Heart Rate 0 + ECG Flat + all Tissue Glucose Use 0.
quirks.pump_note: Insulin pump lives on Infusion Pumps (117) AND as a pump box on the Insulin page (357). Verify interventions via ICS vars 'Insulin Pump, Setting' (rate, mU/min) / 'Insulin Pump, Switch' (0/1); infusion stops on Switch=0 while Setting is retained.
quirks.canvas_click_deaf: Canvas-drawn widgets (Posture list, Treadmill Type/Run radios, Planner schedule rows, drawn page '!' triggers) do NOT respond to synthetic mouse clicks: SendMessage (hummod_click default), PostMessage (method='post'), and real-mouse (blocked by the LockApp lock-screen backstop in this environment) all fail. Right-clicking the canvas opens a modal TrackPopupMenu that blocks the sending call forever (hummod_click hang); PostMessage WM_CANCELMODE to the main window unwedges it but the engine process may then EXIT (observed crash). Drive such state via Win32 radios/sliders or ICS save-edit-load instead.
quirks.ics_loader_protected: Load ICs silently resets some control-state vars to defaults regardless of file content: 'Exercise, Goal'->0, 'Exercise, Is On Treadmill'->0, 'Treadmill, Speed (MPH)'->5.0. 'Treadmill, Run Or Walk' DOES load (=1 verified). 'Posture Control, Default Posture' loads (1=Lying, 2=Sitting, 3=Standing, 4=Tilting; Result/Is-* follow after a solve step).
quirks.planner_exercise_route: The only fully programmable exercise channel: Daily Planner/Control (69) Switch radios (Win32 1199 Off/1200 On) + its Win32 'Work Level' slider + the built-in schedule (8-11 AM = Work by default). Advancing the clock to 8 AM starts Working automatically: 'Exercise, Using Daily Planner'->1, Goal->3, Is Working->1, subject stands. Work intensity = 'Daily Planner, Work Level' (slider pos x10, cap 150). Is Working stays 1 with Level=0 while the scheduled hour runs (intensity 0 = rest). 'Exercise, Goal' enums seen: 0 resting, 3 working.
quirks.o2_intervention: Air Supply (80): Gas Tanks Switch radios (Win32; sorted-by-id ordinals 0/1 = Pressure Chamber Off/On ids 1075/1076, 2/3 = Gas Tanks Off/On ids 1077/1078 - id order is NOT visual order). [O2]/[N2] valve sliders are linear (pos = percent). Inspired O2% = O2valve/(O2valve+N2valve); N2 valve floor is 19% (pos 0 -> 19) so max inspired O2 is 84% (639 mmHg), not 100%. Inspired air updates only after a solve step.
quirks.baseline_subject: Default subject 'Mr. Norm or Ms. Norma': age 37, height 178 cm, weight 77.5 kg, BSA 1.95 m^2, GCS 15, resting/awake/normal signs, lying posture. Baseline values are the t=0 state right after Restart (X=0).
quirks.baseline_units: Units come from QCP Lab Manual 2006.DOC, section 'Normal Values' (the manual's own normal-value table = the exercise's parameter list): Plasma [AII] pG/mL, Plasma [Aldosterone] pMol/L, Plasma [ANP] pMol/L, Plasma [Erythropoietin] mU/mL, Plasma [Insulin] uU/mL, Plasma [Glucagon] pG/mL, Venous [ADH] pG/mL, Plasma Renin Activity (no unit stated), Metabolic Rate kCal/Min (= Watts/41.84), TPR mmHg/(mL/Min), Ventilation L/Min, [Glucose]/[Fatty Acids]/[Triglycerides]/[Ketoacids] mG/dL, [H+] nEq/L.
quirks.find_dialog_note: Find > FIND VARIABLE'S PANEL has 580 Category entries; the Item list holds the variable's sub-variables ('Mass', 'Blood Flow', 'Conc (mG/dL)' ...) and the Panel list holds the pages that display it. hummod_open_panel MUST be given category= : without it every category is scanned (engine repopulates the Item list per category) and the call exceeds the 30 s MCP timeout with the Find dialog left open. Panel names are canvas pages: 'Brain - Circulation', 'Skeletal Muscle - Circulation', 'GI Lumen - Food', 'Liver - Glucose / Glycogen', 'Fat - Lipid Dynamics'.
quirks.clipboard_is_image: Edit > Copy / Select All do NOT copy page text: Options > Clipboard... opens 'Clipboard Images' with only Bitmap/Metafile buttons. There is no programmatic text export of a page - the panel screenshot (hummod_shot) is the only machine-readable view of a QCP page.
quirks.restart_idempotent: Restart at t=0 is idempotent: the ICS exported right after engine start and right after Restart are byte-identical (1367 VAR lines).

find_panels.note: Panel names as they appear in the Find dialog's Panel list (opened with hummod_open_panel). These pages are NOT in the menu tree until their View group is enabled.
find_panels.Brain - Circulation: Brain blood flow (845 mL/min), perfusion pressure, vascular conductance
find_panels.Fat - Lipid Dynamics: Lipid deposit mass (10000 G), triglyceride uptake, fatty acid release

Daily Planner/Control.note: 5 Win32 scrollbars, all ctrl_id 0; ordinal = z-order = 0 Meals Duration, 1 Aerobics Duration, 2 Aerobics Level, 3 Work Duration, 4 Work Level
Daily Planner/Control.work_level: pos 0-15 -> value = pos*10 (0/50/100/150...), pos >=15 caps at 150 (the model's max sustained work rate); verify via 'Daily Planner, Work Level'

Air Supply.note: 6 Win32 scrollbars, all ctrl_id 0; ordinal = z-order; visual rows top->bottom: [O2] 172, [N2] 191, [CO2] 210, CO PPM ~249, Anesthetic ~268, chamber Atm ~342 -> ordinals 5,4,3,2,1,0
Air Supply.inspired_o2: inspired O2% = O2valve/(O2valve+N2valve); with O2=100, N2=19 -> 84% (639 mmHg)

Diet.ordinal_to_control: 0=H2O, 1=SO4-, 2=PO4-, 3=K+, 4=Extra Cl-, 5=Extra Na+, 6=Table Salt, 7=Protein, 8=Fat, 9=Carbo's (sliders sorted by ctrl_id, all 0 -> z-order, descending y)

Infusion Pumps.layout: 11 pump rows: right column top->bottom = ADH, Lactic Acid, Erythropoietin, Norepinephrine, Insulin; left column = All, ANP, Aldosterone, Epinephrine, Glucose, Ketoacid. All rate scrollbars have ctrl_id 0 -> ordinal = z-order; ordinal 0 = Insulin rate (verified by probe).
Infusion Pumps.insulin_rate_mU_min: pos 0-20 -> value=pos; pos 21-28 -> 30+10*(pos-21); pos 29-37 -> 200+100*(pos-29); >=38 (and >=40) cap at 1000. pos 20 = 20 (normal secretion), pos 29 = 200 mU/min.
Infusion Pumps.verify: read 'Insulin Pump, Setting' via hummod_snapshot after each move

Control.note: Daily Planner Switch radios have readable captions (Off id 1199 / On id 1200); ordinal order = ctrl_id order

Air Supply.note: ids 1075/1076 = Pressure Chamber (visual y~322), 1077/1078 = Gas Tanks (y~153); id order is NOT visual order; verify via inspired-air shot after a solve step

Infusion Pumps.note: 11 Off/On pairs (ids 1016-1037), ascending id = right column bottom->top then left column bottom->top; Insulin pair = ordinals 0 (Off, id 1016) / 1 (On, id 1017). Native check states are unreliable on QCP - always probe with ['Insulin Pump, Switch', 'Insulin Pump, Setting'].
